mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm (alarm_type, chip_uid, slot_no, message, session_id, acknowledged, created_at) VALUES (#{alarmType}, #{chipUid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{slotNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{message}, #{sessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{acknowledged}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, alarm_type, chip_uid, slot_no, message, session_id, acknowledged, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at, created_at FROM alarm ORDER BY acknowledged ASC, id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm SET acknowledged = true, acknowledged_by = #{accountId}, acknowledged_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND acknowledged = false
